author: Unreal Sensei
description:
Unreal Engine 5.8 launched and it revolutionizes the way we create landscapes and render lighting. UE5.8 now has Mesh Terrain which is Unreal's next generation landscape system that lets us sculpt 3D landscape geometry. Also introduced is Lumen Probe Occlusion which is a more optimized and faster way to achieve global illumination.
